objective: Improve five-run exact agreement without changing schemas, model, runtime, or Python routing.

M.hypothesis: An explicit precedence rule and atomic molecular-layer inventory will reduce multiomics_evidence disagreement.

D.hypothesis: A single frozen routing anchor will reduce design_families disagreement while preserving causal_basis routing.

selection_rule: Maximize all-tracked-fields exact agreement on development.
Reject an arm if decision-driving agreement or route agreement is lower than A0.
Break ties by decision-driving agreement, then fewer retry failures, then the smaller prompt change.
Freeze the selected arm before opening the sealed holdout.
Do not tune on sealed-holdout results.
interpretation_constraint: This experiment measures reproducibility, not model-to-expert validity.
